title: Standard WOFOST one-day evolution readiness gate

WOF25_G01_complete_continuation_state.result: physical continuation includes crop lifecycle, TSUM/anthesis, nofd/atmin7 and F-WOF23 biomass/cohorts; IDSL2 adds vern/fl_vernalised. Exact B1.10 code continuation additionally has two narrowly scoped reference-compatibility memories: GLAIEXP carryover after its threshold and VERNRATE carryover where IDSL2 requires it.

WOF25_G02_minimal_committed_state.result: derived fields and inactive-option state are excluded; active cohorts are compact; exact-code compatibility memory is scalar and conditional rather than the full legacy rate object

WOF25_G03_rates_are_not_state.result: ordinary phenology, assimilation, growth, death and allocation rates are event-local. Exact B1.10 continuation must either preserve narrow GLAIEXP and VERNRATE carryover semantics or qualify an explicit theory-code expected difference. The full WOFOST_rates object is never persistent per column.

WOF25_G04_daily_forcing_contract.result: TMN, TAV, TAVD, radiation, solar geometry and active CO2 factors are explicit event/provider inputs; hidden calendar globals are forbidden

WOF25_G05_cross_process_aggregates.result: IQROT/IPTRA/IALPWET are accepted window aggregates only; rejected soil-water trials contribute zero
WOF25_G05_cross_process_aggregates.option_hold: production owner for active oxygen IALPWET window accumulation across composed runtime intervals is not claimed by F-WOF25

WOF25_G06_explicit_evolution_event.result: one explicit crop event/window with [t0,t1], first admitted duration one day; runtime schedules it and kernel time remains generic

WOF25_G07_transaction_semantics.result: prepare, aggregate and finalize are candidate-only; F-KT remains the only commit/rollback authority; enabled compatibility memory follows the same reference candidate lineage and rollback/replay semantics

WOF25_G08_soil_water_cadence.result: many soil-water substeps may occur inside a crop window; WOFOST evolution and cohort shifting occur once at the crop's physical cadence

WOF25_G09_threshold_event_semantics.result: emergence, anthesis, vernalization, LAIEXP threshold carryover, cohort shifting, root changes and maturity are cadence-sensitive; arbitrary split/merge equivalence is explicitly unqualified

WOF25_G10_MultiSWAP_scalability.result: parameter sharing, compact active cohorts, option-dependent physical state, conditional reference compatibility memory and worker-local ordinary rates are compatible with SoA/pools/batching

readiness_decision.meaning: the zero-production source-bound contracts now identify both physical continuation and the legacy-code compatibility memory needed to avoid inventing temporal semantics in a structural candidate

recommended_first_structural_profile.reference_compatibility: implement the conditional GLAIEXP carryover on any exact B1.10 reference path, or explicitly restrict the first qualification envelope to pre-carryover trajectories and mark the remainder unqualified
recommended_first_structural_profile.IDSL: prefer 0 or 1 initially so the optional VERNRATE carryover and vernalization state can be composed later
recommended_first_structural_profile.root_state: prefer reconstructible/nonadaptive root geometry before composing optional SWRD2/SWRDC1 history
recommended_first_structural_profile.oxygen_same_window_export: exclude initially unless the runtime accepted-window aggregator owner is composed explicitly

holds_not_blocking_restricted_structural: IDSL2 vernalization and its exact-code VERNRATE carryover may be deferred by choosing IDSL0/1 for the first candidate
production runtime owner for active oxygen IALPWET crop-window accumulation across smaller committed intervals
concrete optional SWRD2/SWRDC1 root-history carrier composition
arbitrary subdaily or multiday WOFOST evolution
full-route scientific decision on whether legacy GLAIEXP carryover is preserved as reference compatibility or promoted to an explicit theory-code expected difference
hard_rule_for_exact_reference: A structural candidate may not claim exact B1.10 continuation beyond the LAIEXP carryover threshold unless it transports the source-bound carryover memory or independently qualifies a declared expected difference.
next_unit_rule: do not start production work in F-WOF25; choose the next free F-WOF work-unit code live and make it the smallest structural one-day candidate constrained by the profile above
